items.title: Lennar (LEN) Faces Class Action Lawsuit Over Millrose Spin Off
items.summary: Lennar (NYSE:LEN) has been named in a new class action lawsuit alleging misleading conduct related to its Millrose spin off. Plaintiffs claim Lennar misrepresented how its operating strategy and Millrose structure affected reported financial performance and home sale activity. The suit alleges Millrose was used in a way that artificially supported Lennar home sales metrics presented to investors. The class action over the Millrose spin off sits alongside wider questions our research has...

items.title: Berkshire Hathaway Doubles Down on U.S. Housing
items.summary: Berkshire Hathaway nearly doubled its stake in home builder Lennar, adding to its bet on the U.S. housing industry, while confirming its position in Italian web-services firm Bending Spoons.
